items.title: IBD Stock Of The Day: GE Aerospace Rises In Buy Zone After Earnings Letdown
items.summary: GE Aerospace stock rose on Friday, capping a week of gains that left it squarely within a buy zone.  Shares rose 1.5% as they rebounded from key technical support.  Like most aerospace stocks, GE Aerospace has had a year of ups and downs that has nonetheless yielded gains thus far.

items.title: Why GE (NYSE:GE) Is Looking Interesting In The Aerospace And Defense Sector
items.summary: Global growth signals look more supportive across Europe, the US, and several emerging markets, while inflation and interest rate expectations remain in focus. In this kind of mixed but improving backdrop, many investors are looking at businesses tied to long-cycle spending and government budgets rather than short-term consumer swings.
